58/S0.subgoal: Describe the stages of the 3D graphics pipeline.

58/S1.subgoal: Explain the scan conversion (rasterization) stage and the mapping from continuous to discrete coordinate systems.

58/S2.subgoal: Describe line rendering algorithms, specifically Bresenham's, and explain how they avoid floating-point operations.

58/S3.subgoal: Explain aliasing, the need for anti-aliasing, and the computational complexity of rendering in VR.

58/S4.subgoal: Describe how developers implement the graphics pipeline using libraries, APIs, and a layered architecture.

58/S5.subgoal: Explain how GPU hardware exploits parallelism to accelerate the graphics pipeline.

58/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
